_comment: Instant booking for the paid consultation. Each option is a Stripe payment link; configure that link in Stripe to redirect after successful payment to `calendarUrl`, so one click takes someone from choosing a format to holding a slot. While a `url` is empty the page falls back to the enquiry form, so it is never broken. `vatRate` is what the Stripe link must add on top of the shown price.
